ravi: FYI reproducible goroutine leak in the go generator sample when cancelling during token-refresh/handshake. tiny harness + gist attached: https://internal.gists/redwood/go-stream-repro
emma: can you paste the minimal stack?
ravi: reader goroutine stuck on `authCh` receive, refresher goroutine stuck on send. happens when user ctx is cancelled mid-handshake. example stacks show stream.reader.run and auth.refresher.loop.
oliver: likely root cause: refresher does `authCh <- token` without selecting on ctx.Done(), so if reader returned the send blocks forever. simple fix: select on ctx.Done() when notifying.
emma: agreed. bigger question: API ergonomics. current `Subscribe()` returns a channel and spawns runtime goroutines, which makes cancellation ownership fuzzy. propose small v2 ergonomics: `Pull(ctx, req) (Stream, error)` where `Stream.Recv(ctx) (Chunk, error)` and `Stream.Close()` are explicit. callers pass ctx into Recv so deadlines/cancels are honored.

ravi: I prototyped Recv/Close and added `TestStreamCancelDuringHandshake` in `stream/stream_test.go`. master leaks ~3 goroutines per cancel; patched branch with Recv+select-on-ctx shows zero leaks. CI repro: https://ci.internal/streams/3791

oliver: keep `Subscribe()` as a compatibility shim that adapts the new Stream API to a channel and emits a deprecation log. that keeps existing users working while we roll out v2.
emma: docs+parity: Python/TS close net.Conn on cancel which unwinds goroutines. Go should prefer explicit Recv/Close semantics but we must document the behavioral diff and add migration guidance. add a short section in `docs/sdk/go/streaming.md`.

ci-bot: created issue #5401 "go sdk: generator stream hang during token refresh" and linked PR candidate branch ravi/stream-pull.

oliver: UX nit: example should show `ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(...)` then `defer cancel()` and `defer stream.Close()` at top, plus a `for { chunk, err := stream.Recv(ctx); if err != nil { break } }` pattern. newbies will copy that.
emma: include changelog note and Dedicated migration guide for infra-heavy customers. also add a benchmark `BenchmarkStreamRecv` to ensure Recv(ctx) overhead is negligible.
ravi: I'll open RFC rfc/001-go-streaming-pull-api.md + PR with repro, unit tests, shim, and updated example under `sdk/go/examples/generator-pull`. tagging @emma @oliver @ci-bot for review :thumbsup:
